$description: Rhythm/position/content rules JSON Schema cannot express. Each rule id is implemented by schema/semantic_validate.py (verify_all.py checks the two sets are identical).

rules.rule: The node sequence must equal the DECLARED template's node list: same sections, same order, all required present, no foreign or repeated sections, region must match the template node's region.
spec.route must be one of the declared template's routes (only '/' exists).
chrome.overlays must be the first node.
Exactly one hero (hero.headline-ticker), immediately after chrome.overlays. No exception exists: the only template has a hero.
Every section type in this repo appears exactly once on the only observed page; no section may repeat.
All region:'main' nodes must be contiguous, after the hero and before the CTA (they render inside <main class=content>).
shell.footer must be the last node.
problem.funnel-cards and benefits.funnel-split share the review-funnel illustration; they should not be adjacent (observed 3 sections apart).
node.motion.pattern must be one of the section contract's allowedPatterns.
node.motion.reducedMotionFallback must be the fallback pinned to the pattern in motion/motion-contract.json.
Every text field must respect its section contract's maxWords budget.

Every href must be '#', '#fragment' or a root-relative internal path. http(s)://, protocol-relative //, mailto:, tel:, javascript:, data: are rejected (all outbound links were removed from this clone on request).
A root-relative href must be a declared template route or a declared dead internal route.
Links to the dead internal routes /terms and /privacy are allowed only inside shell.footer.
Every assetRole used by a node must be in that section contract's assetRoles (and exist in assets/asset-roles.json).

Every media/content-role item's source must be in that role's allowedSources; protected roles (real Rig marks, real third-party logos, real news headlines) only accept placeholder or user-supplied-licensed - never generated.
node.surface must exist in tokens/llm/token-catalog.json and equal the section contract's surfaceToken (chrome.overlays has none).
meta.ogImage must be a protected-role media object; there is no canonical/og:url/JSON-LD field (removed from the clone).
